faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about shopping with MagicOFit.
faq.stillHaveQuestionsDesc: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Our customer service team is here to help.

q1.q: What payment methods do you accept?
q1.a: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and cash on delivery for eligible orders.

q2.a: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days within Egypt. Express shipping is available for 1-2 business day delivery.

q3.a: We offer a 30-day return policy for all unused items in their original packaging. Simply contact us to initiate a return, and we'll provide a prepaid shipping label.

q4.a: Currently, we only ship within Egypt. We're working on expanding to other countries in the near future.

q5.q: How can I track my order?
q5.a: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking number. You can use this to track your package on our website or the carrier's website.

q6.q: What if I receive a damaged or defective item?
q6.a: Please contact us immediately with photos of the damage. We'll arrange for a free replacement or full refund, including return shipping.

q7.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
q7.a: Orders can be cancelled within 1 hour of placement. After that, please contact our customer service team and we'll do our best to accommodate your request.

q8.a: Yes! We offer digital and physical gift cards in various denominations. They make perfect gifts for the athletes in your life.

q9.q: How do I know which size to order?
q9.a: Each product page includes a detailed size guide with measurements. If you're still unsure, our customer service team can help you find the right fit.

q10.a: Absolutely! We source all our products directly from authorized distributors and brands. Every item is 100% authentic and comes with manufacturer warranties.

shipping.title: Shipping Information
shipping.sameDayDesc: Available in Cairo, Giza, and Alexandria only. Order before 2 PM.
shipping.policy1: We strive to process and ship all orders within 1-2 business days. Orders placed on weekends or holidays will be processed on the next business day.
shipping.policy2: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with your tracking number. You can track your package on our website or the carrier's website.
shipping.policy3: We ship to all addresses within Egypt. We do not currently offer international shipping, but we're working on expanding to other countries.
shipping.policy4: For large or heavy items (such as gym equipment), additional shipping fees may apply. You'll be notified of any additional charges before your order is processed.
shipping.majorCities: Major Cities: Cairo, Alexandria, Giza, Mansoura, Tanta
shipping.sameDayAvailable: Same-Day Delivery: Available in Cairo, Giza, and Alexandria
shipping.expressAvailable: Express Delivery: Available in all major cities
shipping.tracking1: To track your order, use the tracking number provided in your shipping confirmation email. You can also track your order from your account dashboard on our website.
shipping.tracking2: If you have any questions about your shipment or if your tracking information shows no movement for more than 3 days, please contact our customer service team.
shipping.haveQuestionsDesc: Our customer service team is here to help with any shipping-related questions.

returns.policy2: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery
returns.policy3: Items must be unused and in original packaging

about.title: About MagicOFit
about.intro: MagicOFit is your premier destination for premium sports gear and equipment. Founded with a passion for athletics and a commitment to quality, we bring you the best products from the world's leading sports brands.
about.missionDesc: To empower athletes of all levels with high-quality sports equipment that enhances performance, promotes safety, and inspires greatness. We believe that everyone deserves access to the best gear, whether you're a professional athlete or just starting your fitness journey.
about.qualityDesc: We only stock products from trusted brands with proven track records.
about.performanceDesc: Every product is selected for its ability to enhance athletic performance.
about.customerServiceDesc: Our team of sports enthusiasts is here to help you find the perfect gear.
about.sustainabilityDesc: We're committed to reducing our environmental impact through responsible sourcing.
about.story1: MagicOFit was born from a simple observation: athletes deserve better access to premium sports equipment. Our founders, former athletes themselves, understood the frustration of searching for quality gear across multiple stores and websites.
about.story2: Today, we've grown into a trusted destination for sports enthusiasts across the region, offering a curated selection of running shoes, training apparel, gym equipment, and more. Our team carefully selects each product based on quality, performance, and value.
